rules: Inspect actual saved output using view_image before judging.
Trace actor-relative ownership and actual tip/target contact; object proximity or prompt mention alone fails.
Partial or unobservable evidence fails a complete strict gate.
Credit a source contribution only with sampled source provenance, absent-baseline final literal delta, exact native transport and a corresponding saved-image observation.
Appearance similarity is visual-only; identity and age are not inferred.
Keep generic inspiration, native whole-source qualification, whole-scene fidelity, causal improvement and requester acceptance separate.
Compare prior failed relations individually; counts with different denominators are not an improvement measure.
